Copy files between the host and a VM.

```text
pomme cp SOURCE DESTINATION [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `SOURCE` | Host path or `NAME:/absolute/path` endpoint. |
| `DESTINATION` | Host path or `NAME:/absolute/path` endpoint. A destination ending in / (or an existing host directory) receives the source's file name. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
